newsitem.title: JAPAN: French President Chirac arrives in Japan.
newsitem.headline: French President Chirac arrives in Japan.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac arrived in Tokyo on Sunday at the start of a six-day visit to boost economic ties and restore relations damaged by last year's French nuclear tests in the South Pacific.
In a Japanese newspaper interview on the eve of his arrival, Chirac said France also wanted Tokyo to play a more active role in international affairs.
"In a period of world crisis France looks to Japan as an important player to consult with," Chirac told the Asahi Shimbun newspaper.

The Franco-Japanese summit is intended to "restore" bilateral relations, according to Japanese officials, after Japanese public outrage exploded at France's South Pacific nuclear tests which began in September last year.
Economic talks are expected to focus on French demands that Japan open its insurance, construction, aircraft and car manufacturing industries to French companies.
